title: kith-tui: use session accountId instead of hardcoded a-self
description: event.rs hardcodes accountId "a-self" in ~10 JMAP calls. JMAP accountIds are opaque (RFC 8620 1.6.2); chinwag assigns real ones, so every call fails accountNotFound. ClientSession::account_id() already parses primaryAccounts; thread it through.
close_reason: accountId from session threaded through all calls; regression test requests_carry_session_account_id
